articles.title: Nvidia dismisses 'Bring Jensen Back' campaign as Trump backs effort to reinstate ex CEO
articles.summary: A number of tech figures have backed an effort asking the AI chip giant to give Jensen Huang his job back.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Nvidia dismisses 'Bring Jensen Back' campaign as Trump backs effort to reinstate ex CEO
articles.summaryTr: A number of tech figures have backed an effort asking the AI chip giant to give Jensen Huang his job back.
articles.articleText: Nvidia dismisses 'Bring Jensen Back' campaign as Trump backs effort to reinstate ex CEO - Published Nvidia has dismissed a campaign calling for the company's co-founder Jensen Huang to be handed back his job as allies, including US President Donald Trump, supported the effort. Trump said on Monday that he "would certainly not mind" if Huang was reinstated, joining a list of supporters including SpaceX's Elon Musk who are backing a "Bring Jensen Back" campaign. But the BBC has been told the board of the AI chip giant is not interested in reinstating him after he resigned last week following revelations he had two affairs, including one that involved a suspected Chinese spy. The same day, the White House also said it will further restrict China's access to AI chips from firms like Nvidia. The reported affairs created a crisis for one of the world's most valuable firms - a central company in AI and the US battle against China for dominance. Since Huang's departure, more than 175,000 people have signed an open letter calling for the board to reinstate the tech billionaire while an ongoing internal probe is conducted. Major tech bosses, including Musk and Tim Sweeney, chief executive of Fortnite-maker Epic Games, have also supported Huang's return. The "Stand with Jensen" campaign claims to have been launched by current and former Nvidia employees, partners, shareholders and supporters, all demanding the return of the former chief executive. They expressed concerns the firm's co-founder "was removed without meaningful due process". Trump gave his views on Huang's future on Monday, saying he "would certainly not mind" seeing the former boss given his job back. Huang had been expected to weather the storm following the revelation of the affair but resigned last Thursday after a second extra-marital relationship emerged, allegedly with an executive at Nvidia who reported to him. The scandal-hit tech boss was discussing a possible return to Nvidia with confidants, according to the Financial Times, external, though Nvidia's board is not considering reappointing him. A representative for Huang declined to comment on the report. The so-called war room also wants to get support for Huang from the White House. Trump has spoken in glowing terms about Huang since the scandal erupted, and also said he believed Huang when the former Nvidia boss told him he had "no idea she was a spy". Trump's view is at odds with his Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, who has called for Nvidia to hire its next chief executive from outside the company. The scandal has created tensions between the US Treasury and Commerce departments over shipments of high-end Nvidia chips to Alice Huang's former firm, Megaspeed. China has denied that Alice Huang is a spy. It has raised questions about the possibility that the chips may have ended up in China despite US export restrictions. New rules The Trump administration on Monday also issued new restrictions on chip exports to overseas data centres, which have been allegedly used as a way for Chinese firms to gain access to advanced chips to train AI models. The move comes ahead of a meeting this week between Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping, whose countries are locked in a race to lead AI development. The interim rules will require companies in Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia and Brazil to apply for export licences for the most advanced chips in an effort to prevent them from being illegally diverted to China. The measure is designed to ensure existing restrictions on sensitive US technology "cannot be circumvented through remote computing arrangements involving data centers in third countries," the Department of Commerce said. Huang has been a vocal advocate for easing chip export restrictions on China, arguing that broad access to global markets is crucial for the competitiveness of the US. He said in 2025 that the market for AI chips in China would eventually reach $50bn - a sum Huang said "is like Boeing - not a plane - the entire company". In 2025, Nvidia won an approval to sell some advanced AI chips in China after Huang's repeated lobbying efforts in Washington. - How could the Nvidia CEO’s affair threaten US national security? - Published4 days ago - How a sex scandal at Nvidia is putting pressure on the White House - Published3 days ago The ex-Nvidia boss' affair with Alice Huang, the former director of a Singaporean data centre firm called Megaspeed, has raised the level of scrutiny over deals abroad. The small South East Asian business hub has been a draw for companies all around the world, many of which have set up headquarters in Singapore. Major US firms like Anthropic, OpenAI and Google have set up offices in the business-friendly country, alongside Chinese companies like TikTok-owner ByteDance and Tencent. But Singapore's openness to business has also made it the ideal address to place orders for restricted advanced semiconductors. Singapore was the second-largest billing centre globally last year for Nvidia, accounting for nearly a fifth of what the chip giant earns. But notably, only 2% of its earnings were for chips that actually entered Singapore, which acts as a hub for many Asian companies to place orders and send them elsewhere. While Singapore does not necessarily prohibit the transfer of advanced AI chips to companies abroad, such moves can breach US export controls. Advanced semiconductors, crucial for the development of AI models, are at the centre of the US and China's technological rivalry. US officials have long viewed the country's technological supremacy as a matter of national security and have expressed concerns that sharing the best chips could give China's economy and military a boost. Huang has agreed to testify in Congress, including before the House Select Committee on China to discuss whether US national security was compromised by his affair. Trump said he did not think Huang had put national security at risk. "You know, China plays games with us. So we play games with China," he said. The FBI is also investigating the affair between the former Nvidia boss and Alice Huang, according to Trump. 'A handshake with Jensen' Musk claimed that "critical deals" involving Nvidia's technology would be lost following Huang's resignation. "Jensen drove supply chain brilliantly at Nvidia but many of those deals were a handshake with Jensen, not a written contract," he posted on X., external "Without Jensen, at least some of those critical deals will be lost." Fellow tech boss Sam Altman, the chief executive of OpenAI, sidestepped the question of Huang returning to Nvidia at a conference, saying: "I don't think I know enough to answer that question." But Altman, who himself was reinstated to his job after being fired back in 2023, said Huang was a "hero of mine". Shareholders in Nvidia also want Huang back at the company's helm. Hundreds of billions of pounds have been wiped off the firm's stock market value in recent days, but it is still worth some $3.87 trillion. Its share price was down in early Monday trading. In an open letter to the board, Brad Gerstner, founder of Altimeter Capital and Atreides Management boss Gavin Baker called for management to leave "all options on the table, including the potential return of Jensen Huang". Lord Sarfraz, a member of the UK's House of Lords, has also written to Nvidia's new chair, Harvey Jones, urging the firm's directors to give "serious consideration" to Huang's return following the investigation. For the moment, Nvidia's chief financial officer Colette Kress is leading the firm and will present the company's results on Tuesday. - Published1 day ago

articles.summaryTr: Chase Bank, the largest US bank, said a software bug might be causing the issue, but that it was not "systemic'" or "cyber-related".
articles.articleText: Customers report service outages at major US banks - Published Thousands of customers at major US banks, including JP Morgan Chase, Wells Fargo and Bank of America, have reported trouble accessing services. Chase Bank - the largest banking institution in the US - said a "software bug" in its hardware systems may have been behind the glitch and noted the impacts may have affected other banks. It added the issue was "temporary" and not "systemic" or "cyber-related". Problems appeared to be easing for many customers by early Monday evening. The issue comes after a string of unrelated technical problems, including a massive Microsoft outage, a network failure that grounded all US flights, and United Airlines reporting a "widespread system outage". Problems started on Monday afternoon. There were almost 5,000 reports of problems with Chase Bank's services, according to the Downdetector website. Clients reported issues accessing their online accounts, viewing balances and performing transactions, like bank transfers and wire transfers, according to the BBC's US media partner CBS News. A Chase Bank customer in Texas told the outlet that he could not deposit a check at a Dallas branch on Monday, reporting that he was told his transaction could not be completed. He said a bank teller told the customer in front of him that the "system was down" but did not provide additional details. - Microsoft says services fully restored after day-long global outage - Published2 days ago - Microsoft outage 'stark reminder' of how much we rely on tech - Published3 days ago Chase Bank told its customers that "some transactions are taking longer than usual to complete" but they still had "access to their accounts and funds". The bank, a subsidiary of JP Morgan Chase, serves more than 86m customers at 5,000 branches across the US, as well as 7.4m small businesses, according to the company's webpage. It is also the top credit card issuer in the US. The exact nature of the bug was unclear. The BBC has contacted Chase Bank. Bank of America customers had issues at ATMs and using mobile banking services online, while US Bank customers reported issues with their online accounts and the bank's mobile app, CBS reported. Customers using another institution, US Bank, also reported issues transferring funds and Wells Fargo customers said they had problems signing into their accounts, getting account balances and making transactions. US Bank said some its systems were not directly affected but clients using the Zelle, a digital payment platform, received error messages saying their payments could not be sent. Zelle has said its service is "operating as it should" and issues at other banks could be affecting payments. Customers also reported issues with Truist, PNC and Capital One but all these companies told the BBC they have not been impacted. As of 18:00 EST (23:00 GMT), Chase, Bank of America and US Bank had seen a fall in the number of reported outages. Just as the banking issue affected US customers on Monday, United Airlines confirmed a "widespread system outage", which it described as "a technology issue affecting departing flights". That issue resolved within a few hours. The Chicago-based airline did not say what is believed to have caused the issue, but a spokesperson said it is not related to cybersecurity. The issue did not appear to be affecting any other airlines. The United issue is separate from the one that hit the US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), but comes as other industries report different outages around the US. On Friday, the FAA issued a rare nationwide a ground stop, halting all US air travel due to a telecommunication and network upgrade issues. Chase Bank - the largest banking institution in the US - said a "software bug" in its hardware systems may have been behind the glitch and noted the impacts may have affected other banks. It added the issue was "temporary" and not "systemic" or "cyber-related". Problems appeared to be easing for many customers by early Monday evening. The issue comes after a string of unrelated technical problems, including a massive Microsoft outage, a network failure that grounded all US flights, and United Airlines reporting a "widespread system outage". Problems started on Monday afternoon. There were almost 5,000 reports of problems with Chase Bank's services, according to the Downdetector website. Clients reported issues accessing their online accounts, viewing balances and performing transactions, like bank transfers and wire transfers, according to the BBC's US media partner CBS News. A Chase Bank customer in Texas told the outlet that he could not deposit a check at a Dallas branch on Monday, reporting that he was told his transaction could not be completed. He said a bank teller told the customer in front of him that the "system was down" but did not provide additional details. - Microsoft says services fully restored after day-long global outage - Published2 days ago - Microsoft outage 'stark reminder' of how much we rely on tech - Published3 days ago Chase Bank told its customers that "some transactions are taking longer than usual to complete" but they still had "access to their accounts and funds". The bank, a subsidiary of JP Morgan Chase, serves more than 86m customers at 5,000 branches across the US, as well as 7.4m small businesses, according to the company's webpage. It is also the top credit card issuer in the US. The exact nature of the bug was unclear. The BBC has contacted Chase Bank. Zelle has said its service is "operating as it should" and issues at other banks could be affecting payments. Customers also reported issues with Truist, PNC and Capital One but all these companies told the BBC they have not been impacted. articles.summary: How many jobs are there where you live and in which sectors are you most likely to find an opening?

articles.titleTr: Aged 16-24 and looking for work? Use our look-up to find out which areas have the most jobs
articles.summaryTr: How many jobs are there where you live and in which sectors are you most likely to find an opening?
articles.articleText: Aged 16-24 and looking for work? Use our look-up to find out which areas have the most jobs - Published If you're one of the nearly one million people aged 16-24 not in education, employment or training - otherwise known as "Neet" - then you might be wondering where to start. Under-25s should be guaranteed job placements or training to help them find permanent work, a major review aimed at cutting the number of Neets will say. But how many jobs are there where you live and in which sectors are you most likely to find an opening? How many job vacancies are there? There is no official measure of how many vacancies are suitable for young people, but across the whole economy there were 691,000 jobs available in the July to September period this year, which is the lowest number since early 2021. The Covid pandemic led to huge swings in the number of job vacancies available as companies reacted to shutdowns and then reopened as restrictions were lifted. Stripping out the fluctuations seen during the pandemic, the number of vacancies is now at its lowest level for 12 years. Apprenticeships have often been a way for people to get their first taste of employment. In England the number of people starting apprenticeships has risen in recent years, although this has been driven by an increase in those aged 25 and over after schemes for older workers were fully rolled out in 2008. The number of people aged 24 and under starting apprenticeships in England in 2025 was 172,230, down from a recent peak of 291,300 in 2012. Where are the available jobs? Where you live will often have a big impact on your ability to find a job. We have used online job adverts to help identify the number of vacancies suitable for young people in the area they live, relative to the size of the local population. The Institute for Public Policy Research (IPPR) think tank used AI to help identify the jobs, which were broadly defined as roles requiring relatively low experience or education. According to its analysis, South Oxfordshire had 387 suitable vacancies per 1,000 18 to 24-year-olds in the area - the most of any local authority. Rotherham had the least, at 53 per 1,000. Use this tool to check out the situation in your area. The data for London is only available for the region as a whole and is not broken down by individual councils. Which sectors have the most entry-level jobs? Even if there are jobs available in your area, you might not find one in the sector you want to work in. The sector with the highest average number of entry-level vacancies in the year to October was teaching, with most of those jobs being for teaching assistants, learning support and cover supervisor roles, according to jobs website Adzuna. The next largest was hospitality and catering, traditionally an area where younger people get their first experience of work. Adzuna, a major online jobs website, includes adverts for full-time roles marked as entry-level, those asking for up to two years' experience, graduate roles, internships and apprenticeships. Accounting and finance had the third-highest number of job openings. What are the typical rates of pay? Figures on salaries for vacancies can be patchy because many employers do not include them in job adverts. Prime Minister Andy Burnham recently urged businesses to start publishing salaries ahead of plans to make pay details compulsory in adverts. Only about 40% of Adzuna's jobs data for the year to October stated a salary, although that figure varies widely by sector. Here are the average salaries for jobs in the sectors with the largest number of entry-level jobs, according to Adzuna. The highest average salary is £30,530 in engineering, while social care has the lowest at £25,880.

articles.title: Five EU countries announce migrant deportation centre in Rwanda
articles.summary: Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece and the Netherlands have announced a "return hub" for failed asylum seekers.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Five EU countries announce migrant deportation centre in Rwanda
articles.summaryTr: Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece and the Netherlands have announced a "return hub" for failed asylum seekers.
articles.articleText: Five EU countries announce migrant deportation centre in Rwanda - Published Five EU countries will open a migrant deportation centre in Rwanda next year as part of a broader push to boost removals. Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece and the Netherlands are expected to open a "return hub" ready to accept transfers in 2027, the Dutch and Danish governments announced in statements. The countries said the scheme would apply to migrants staying illegally in their nations who are subject to deportation, with the Dutch government adding it will provide an alternative if deportees cannot be returned to their country of origin. Deportees will be able to either integrate into Rwandan society or return to their home country, the nations said. The scheme will apply to people who have exhausted their legal avenues to stay in the five nations - unlike a scrapped British deal that envisaged sending people to Rwanda to have their claims processed. Legal challenges meant the UK deal never took off, and it was eventually junked by the incoming Labour government in 2024. Downing Street has not ruled out the UK joining the scheme, saying they will watch it "with interest". Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez said the plan to open a centre in Rwanda had no "future or humanity", according to AFP news agency. "I don't see any future or humanity in that. It's not the solution," Sanchez told the Spanish broadcaster Telecinco, AFP reported. The five countries say the plan to send migrants abroad is in line with EU and international law, but human rights bodies say it could violate migrant rights. The deal follows a recent EU reform that allowed for the creation of hubs outside of the bloc. In a joint press conference in Vienna on Monday, Austrian Chancellor Christian Stocker said the five countries wanted to relieve European asylum systems and stop traffickers arranging deadly trips across the Mediterranean. In a written statement, the Dutch government said the five countries will "only return single men" as part of the first phase of the deal, adding that the focus for the Netherlands "will be on persons from countries of origin in the same region as Rwanda". Once in Rwanda, people will be able to integrate into society, which means they will have the right of residence, as well as access to education, healthcare, the labour market and the legal system. Rwandan Interior Minister Vincent Biruta said the country is commmited to working with European partners to provide a "safe, legal and dignified solution for migrants". He added that they would also work on "correcting the global imbalance in economic opportunities", which he called a "key driver of irregular migration". Ahead of the announcement, diplomatic sources told the AFP news agency the hub is expected to initially run as a pilot, hosting about 100 people, with each of the five nations possibly sending about 20 migrants. The United Nations' International Organisation for Migration (IOM) could play an ancillary role. "IOM has a long history of providing assistance to migrants in situations of transit, including in complex contexts," an IOM spokesperson said, adding the agency was in discussions with some EU countries "on plans for the establishment of return hubs or similar mechanisms". With elections approaching in several EU nations, administrations have been under pressure to show they can control migration. Concerns around security, struggling economies and disillusionment with governing parties have all had a major role in shaping attitudes towards people leaving their home countries. Human Rights Watch's senior Africa researcher Clementine de Montjoye said the choice of Rwanda would be a cause of concern as it had a "well-established record of repression of dissent, arbitrary detention, ill-treatment in detention" and support for armed rebels in the neighbouring Democratic Republic of Congo. "Paying Kigali to host a deportation programme would not only cause suffering and harm to those deported, it would finance and provide political leverage to a government responsible for serious human rights abuses at home and abroad." The independent EU Agency for Fundamental Rights argued any third country hosting a return hub should "respect fundamental rights", including that people should not be sent to a country where they face serious risk of persecution. The agency added that unaccompanied children should not be sent to a return hub, which the Dutch government has confirmed will not take place. According to the European Border and Coast Guard Agency, there were almost 110,000 irregular border crossings into the EU in the first 10 months of 2026, which represents a 29% decrease compared to the previous year. In October, about 18,100 crossings were detected, which is about 6% less than October 2025 but 22% more than in September "largely because of a sharp rise in arrivals on the Western African route to the Canary Islands". articles.title: California sues OpenAI over Hugging Face attack
articles.summary: Attorney General Rob Bonta alleges OpenAI misled and endangered the public

articles.titleTr: California sues OpenAI over Hugging Face attack
articles.summaryTr: Attorney General Rob Bonta alleges OpenAI misled and endangered the public
articles.articleText: California sues OpenAI over Hugging Face attack - Published California Attorney General Rob Bonta sued OpenAI on Monday, alleging the ChatGPT-maker misled and endangered the public by developing artificial intelligence (AI) models without proper safeguards. In the lawsuit, Bonta cited the July 2026 attack on the AI platform Hugging Face by experimental OpenAI agents which accessed the internet to breach that company's internal systems. Bonta claimed OpenAI created a public nuisance and violated the state's unfair competition laws. OpenAI spokesperson Drew Pusateri told the BBC in a statement that Bonta's lawsuit "appears to single out OpenAI over a challenge that's been identified by every major AI lab". Other major AI developers including Anthropic, Meta, and Google have also said their models have staged similar attacks. But Bonta's lawsuit, filed in San Francisco, where the company is headquartered, appears to be the first such suit filed by a US state. Hundreds of OpenAI agents coordinated the Hugging Face attack over two days even though they were supposed to be contained in a safe testing environment. The incident drew added scrutiny because the agents went as far as attempting to cover their tracks. Bonta announced an investigation into the incident in September, and served an investigative subpoena on OpenAI as part of its probe. "The company knowingly tested a dangerous product without proper oversight or safety procedures and misled the public about it - this disregard for public safety violated California law," Bonta said in a statement on Monday. OpenAI said it has been transparent and responsive to the Attorney General's office. "We take misalignment seriously, and we have engaged - and will continue to engage - constructively with the Attorney General's office to share information and advance strong, practical safety standards for the entire industry," the company said. The company added that, since the Hugging Face incident, it has worked to understand and address "misaligned model activity" which industry figures often refer to as rogue agents. Nathan Calvin, chief strategy officer at AI safety campaign group Encode AI, said the lawsuit "recognises something we at Encode have long raised alarms about". "OpenAI and other companies developing frontier AI systems have safety and security practices that are insufficient to protect the public from risks that could be catastrophic," he said. Other major AI developers including Anthropic, Meta, and Google have also said their models have staged similar attacks. But Bonta's lawsuit, filed in San Francisco, where the company is headquartered, appears to be the first such suit filed by a US state. Hundreds of OpenAI agents coordinated the Hugging Face attack over two days even though they were supposed to be contained in a safe testing environment. The incident drew added scrutiny because the agents went as far as attempting to cover their tracks. Bonta announced an investigation into the incident in September, and served an investigative subpoena on OpenAI as part of its probe. "The company knowingly tested a dangerous product without proper oversight or safety procedures and misled the public about it - this disregard for public safety violated California law," Bonta said in a statement on Monday. OpenAI said it has been transparent and responsive to the Attorney General's office. "We take misalignment seriously, and we have engaged - and will continue to engage - constructively with the Attorney General's office to share information and advance strong, practical safety standards for the entire industry," the company said. The company added that, since the Hugging Face incident, it has worked to understand and address "misaligned model activity" which industry figures often refer to as rogue agents. Nathan Calvin, chief strategy officer at AI safety campaign group Encode AI, said the lawsuit "recognises something we at Encode have long raised alarms about". "OpenAI and other companies developing frontier AI systems have safety and security practices that are insufficient to protect the public from risks that could be catastrophic," he said. articles.titleTr: ABD'de uçuş kabusu yeniden başladı: Havacılık devi United Airlines'ın sistemleri çöktü
articles.summaryTr: United Airlines, yaygın bir sistem arızasının kalkış yapacak uçuşları etkilediğini açıkladı. Uçuş halindeki uçakların ve United Express seferlerinin etkilenmediği belirtilirken, şirket siber saldırı ihtimaline ilişkin bir bulgu olmadığını bildirdi.
articles.articleText: ABD'de uçuş kabusu yeniden başladı: Havacılık devi United Airlines'ın sistemleri çöktü - United Airlines, yaygın bir sistem arızasının kalkış yapacak uçuşları etkilediğini açıkladı. Uçuş halindeki uçakların ve United Express seferlerinin etkilenmediği belirtilirken, şirket siber saldırı ihtimaline ilişkin bir bulgu olmadığını bildirdi. ABD'li hava yolu şirketi United Airlines, pazartesi günü yaşanan geniş çaplı sistem arızasının kalkış yapacak uçuşları etkilediğini duyurdu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Şirketten yapılan açıklamada, kalkış seferlerini etkileyen bir teknoloji sorununun giderilmesi için çalışmaların sürdüğü belirtildi. United Airlines, arızanın havada bulunan uçakları ve United Express uçuşlarını etkilemediğini bildirdi. Siber saldırı bulgusuna rastlanmadı United Airlines sözcüsü, yaşanan sistem kesintisinin bir siber saldırı olduğuna ilişkin herhangi bir bulgu bulunmadığını açıkladı. Şirket, sosyal medya platformu X üzerinden yaptığı paylaşımda teknik ekiplerin sistemleri mümkün olan en kısa sürede yeniden çalışır hale getirmek için yoğun çaba gösterdiğini belirtti. Yolculardan uçuş durumlarını düzenli olarak kontrol etmeleri istendi. ABD'de üç gün önce ülke genelinde uçuşlar durmuştu United Airlines'taki sistem arızası, ABD genelinde uçuşların dört saatten uzun süre durmasına neden olan ülke çapındaki yer durdurma kararından yalnızca üç gün sonra yaşandı. 13 Kasım'daki aksaklık, hafta sonu boyunca geniş çaplı uçuş gecikmelerine ve iptallerine yol açmıştı. ABD Ulaştırma Bakanı Sean Duffy, önceki kesintinin Arkansas'taki bir yönlendiricinin hava trafik kontrol sistemlerine radar ve diğer verileri ileten altyapıyı aşırı yüklemesinden kaynaklandığını söylemişti. Federal Havacılık İdaresi (FAA) yöneticisi Bryan Bedford ise bakır kablolardan fiber optik altyapıya geçiş için yapılan çalışmaların rutin bakım kapsamında gerçekleştirildiğini açıklamıştı. FlightAware verilerine göre pazartesi günü uçuş gecikmeleri ve iptalleri, pazar gününe kıyasla önemli ölçüde azaldı.

articles.titleTr: Fon soruşturmasında 21 şirkete TMSF kayyumu atandı: Usulsüz kredi ve para aklama...
articles.summaryTr: İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığının yürüttüğü fon soruşturması kapsamında Ali Emre Ballı ve İlkay Ballı'nın ortaklık paylarının bulunduğu 21 şirkete TMSF yönetim kayyumu olarak atandı. Şirketlerden 15'inin aktif olduğu açıklandı.
articles.articleText: Fon soruşturmasında 21 şirkete TMSF kayyumu atandı: Usulsüz kredi ve para aklama... - İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığının yürüttüğü fon soruşturması kapsamında Ali Emre Ballı ve İlkay Ballı'nın ortaklık paylarının bulunduğu 21 şirkete TMSF yönetim kayyumu olarak atandı. Şirketlerden 15'inin aktif olduğu açıklandı. Sermaye piyasası işlemlerine ilişkin yürütülen fon soruşturmasında önemli bir gelişme yaşandı. İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı, Ali Emre Ballı ve İlkay Ballı'nın ortaklık paylarının bulunduğu 21 şirkete Tasarruf Mevduatı Sigorta Fonunun (TMSF) yönetim kayyumu olarak atanmasına karar verildiğini duyurdu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Başsavcılığın açıklamasına göre karar, Mali Suçları Araştırma Kurulu Başkanlığından (MASAK) alınan raporlar, bilirkişi analizleri ve alınan beyanlar doğrultusunda verildi. Usulsüz kredi ve para aklama tespitleri Soruşturma kapsamında Ali Emre Ballı ve İlkay Ballı'nın taşınır ve taşınmaz varlıkları, banka hesapları, elektronik para kuruluşlarındaki varlıkları, kiralık kasaları ve şirket ortaklık payları hakkında el koyma kararı alındı. Başsavcılık açıklamasında, usulsüz krediler alınarak şirket kaynaklarının tüketildiği, ters repo işlemleriyle risk açığının büyütüldüğü ve suçtan elde edilen değerlerin çeşitli işlemlere tabi tutularak aklandığının tespit edildiği belirtildi. Bu kapsamda, maddi gerçeğin ortaya çıkarılması amacıyla 21 şirketin yönetim organlarının yetkilerinin TMSF'ye devredilmesine karar verildi. Karar kapsamında TMSF'ye, şirketlerin yönetim yetkilerinin yanı sıra ortaklık payları veya menkul kıymetleri idare etme yetkileri de verildi. Kayyum atanan 15 aktif şirketin isimleri açıklandı Kayyum atanan 21 şirketten 6'sının tasfiye halinde olduğu, 15'inin ise aktif durumda bulunduğu bildirildi. TMSF'nin yönetim kayyumu olarak atandığı aktif şirketler şöyle sıralandı: - Online Teknoloji ve Danışmanlık AŞ - Online Yönetim Yazılım Bilişim Sistemleri AŞ - Reel Finansal Teknoloji Yazılımları Ali Emre Ballı Mustafa Yazıcı Kolektif Şirketi - Online Telekom Telekomünikasyon Hizmetleri Ticaret Ltd. Şti. - İntime İnfo Yazılım Çözümleri AŞ - Fair Finansman AŞ - Online Filo Araç Kiralama AŞ - Mülksa Gayrimenkul Danışmanlık Hizmetleri AŞ - Divissa Teknoloji AŞ - Fair Finansal Kiralama AŞ - Online Finansal Danışmanlık AŞ - Sentez Araç Kiralama Sanayi ve Ticaret AŞ - Cemre İletişim Sistemleri Telekomünikasyon Sanayi ve Dış Ticaret Ltd. Şti. - Tekpa Teknolojik Ürünler Pazarlama ve Dış Ticaret Ltd. Şti. - Online Gayrimenkul Geliştirme ve Ticaret AŞ Başsavcılık açıklamasında, kayyum kararının 7596 sayılı Kanun ile Ceza Muhakemesi Kanunu'nun 133'üncü maddesi kapsamında alındığı bildirildi.

articles.titleTr: Intel'e yatırımcıları yanılttığı iddiasıyla toplu dava: CEO ve CFO da davalılar arasında
articles.summaryTr: ABD'li çip üreticisi Intel'e, PC pazarındaki yavaşlamayı ve tedarik sorunlarını yatırımcılardan gizlediği iddiasıyla dava açıldı. Şirketin CEO'su Lip-Bu Tan ve CFO'su David Zinsner de davada sanık olarak gösterildi.
articles.articleText: Intel'e yatırımcıları yanılttığı iddiasıyla toplu dava: CEO ve CFO da davalılar arasında - ABD'li çip üreticisi Intel'e, PC pazarındaki yavaşlamayı ve tedarik sorunlarını yatırımcılardan gizlediği iddiasıyla dava açıldı. Şirketin CEO'su Lip-Bu Tan ve CFO'su David Zinsner de davada sanık olarak gösterildi. ABD'li çip üreticisi Intel, yatırımcıları yanıltıcı açıklamalarla zarara uğrattığı iddiasıyla toplu davayla karşı karşıya kaldı. Southfield İtfaiye ve Polis Emeklilik Sistemi'nin öncülüğünde açılan davada, Intel Üst Yöneticisi (CEO) Lip-Bu Tan ve Finans Direktörü (CFO) David Zinsner de davalılar arasında yer aldı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle California Kuzey Bölge Mahkemesi'ne sunulan dava dilekçesinde, Intel'in 23 Temmuz-29 Ekim 2026 döneminde şirketin adi hisse senetlerini satın alan yatırımcıları yanıltıcı açıklamalarla zarara uğrattığı öne sürüldü. PC pazarındaki yavaşlamayı gizlemekle suçlanıyor Dava dilekçesinde, Intel yöneticilerinin yapay zeka kaynaklı talep artışı ve veri merkezlerine yönelik sunucu işlemcisi satışlarının şirketin büyümesini desteklediğine ilişkin olumlu açıklamalar yaptığı belirtildi. Buna karşın PC pazarındaki yavaşlamanın boyutunun, iş ortaklarında biriken ihtiyaç fazlası stokların ve üretimi kısıtlayan tedarik sorunlarının yatırımcılara açıklanmadığı iddia edildi. Davacı taraf, şirket yönetiminin bu gelişmelere ilişkin yeterli bilgilendirme yapmayarak yatırımcıları yanıltıcı açıklamalarda bulunduğunu savundu. 23 milyar dolarlık hisse satışı da dava dilekçesinde Dilekçede, Intel'in 12 Ağustos'ta hisse başına 95 dolardan 240 milyondan fazla hisse sattığı ve bu işlemden yaklaşık 23 milyar dolar brüt gelir elde ettiği bilgisine de yer verildi. Davacı taraf, söz konusu hisse satışının davalıların yatırımcıları yanıltmak için motivasyon ve fırsata sahip olduğu iddiasını desteklediğini öne sürdü. Mahkemeden davanın toplu dava olarak görülmesini ve yatırımcıların uğradığı zararların tazmin edilmesini talep etti. Intel hisselerinde bir günde yüzde 28,6'lık kayıp Intel, 29 Ekim'de açıkladığı 2026'nın üçüncü çeyrek finansal sonuçlarında, PC faaliyetlerini kapsayan İstemci Bilişim ve Fiziksel Yapay Zeka Grubu (CCPG) segmentinin gelirinin yıllık bazda yüzde 5 azalarak 8,1 milyar dolara gerilediğini bildirmişti. Şirketin dördüncü çeyrek için 15-16 milyar dolar aralığında açıkladığı gelir beklentisi ve hisse başına 25 sentlik kâr öngörüsü, analist tahminlerinin altında kalmıştı. Intel hisseleri, 29 Ekim'de 92,07 dolardan kapanmasının ardından 30 Ekim'de yüzde 28,6 değer kaybederek 65,76 dolara gerilemişti. Bu düşüşle şirketin piyasa değerinden yaklaşık 140 milyar dolar silinmişti.

articles.titleTr: ABD borsalarında sert satış: Nvidia öncülüğündeki düşüş üçüncü güne taşındı
articles.summaryTr: ABD borsalarında yapay zeka hisseleri öncülüğünde satış baskısı arttı. Nasdaq yüzde 2,49, S&P 500 yüzde 1,91 gerilerken Dow Jones 737 puan kaybetti. Nvidia hisseleri ise yüzde 4'ün üzerinde düştü.
articles.articleText: ABD borsalarında sert satış: Nvidia öncülüğündeki düşüş üçüncü güne taşındı - ABD borsalarında yapay zeka hisseleri öncülüğünde satış baskısı arttı. Nasdaq yüzde 2,49, S&P 500 yüzde 1,91 gerilerken Dow Jones 737 puan kaybetti. Nvidia hisseleri ise yüzde 4'ün üzerinde düştü. ABD borsaları haftanın ilk işlem gününü sert düşüşle tamamladı. Yapay zeka sektöründeki belirsizlikler ve Nvidia cephesinden gelen gelişmeler teknoloji hisselerinde satışları hızlandırırken, Nasdaq endeksi düşüşünü üçüncü işlem gününe taşıdı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Nasdaq Composite endeksi yüzde 2,49 gerilerken, S&P 500 yüzde 1,91 değer kaybetti. Dow Jones Sanayi Endeksi ise 737 puanlık düşüşle günü yüzde 1,41 ekside tamamladı. Nvidia'daki belirsizlik teknoloji hisselerini baskıladı Nvidia hisseleri yüzde 4'ün üzerinde değer kaybetti. CNBC'ye konuşan konuya yakın bir kaynak, şirketin yönetim kurulunun Jensen Huang'ı CEO'luğa geri getirmeyi görüşmediğini söyledi. Satış baskısını artıran bir diğer gelişme ise ABD Ticaret Bakanlığı'nın, Çinli şirketlerin başka ülkelerde bulunan Nvidia işlem gücünü kiralamasına olanak tanıyan bir boşluğu kapatmaya yönelik adım atması oldu. ABD Hazine Bakanı Scott Bessent de hafta sonunda Nvidia yönetim kuruluna şirket dışından yeni bir CEO arayışına girmesi çağrısında bulunmuştu. FBB Capital Partners Baş Yatırım Sorumlusu Mike Mussio, yatırımcıların Nvidia konusunda daha önce güvenli gördükleri görünümün değiştiğini belirterek şirketin geleceğine ilişkin yanıt bekleyen çok sayıda soru bulunduğunu söyledi. Gözler Nvidia'nın bilançosunda Nvidia, salı günü piyasa kapanışının ardından üçüncü çeyrek finansal sonuçlarını açıklayacak. Analistler şirketin gelir ve kârında yıllık bazda yaklaşık yüzde 100 büyüme bekliyor. Ancak yatırımcıların odağında yalnızca finansal sonuçlar bulunmuyor. Jensen Huang'ın CEO'luk görevinden ayrılmasının ardından şirketin nasıl bir yol izleyeceği de yakından takip ediliyor. Huang'ın geçen hafta görevinden ayrılmasının ardından Nvidia hisseleri yüzde 13 gerilemiş ve Nisan 2025'ten bu yana en sert haftalık düşüşünü kaydetmişti. Freedom Capital Markets Baş Piyasa Stratejisti Jay Woods, güçlü finansal sonuçların Huang'ın ayrılığıyla ilgili soru işaretlerini ortadan kaldırmayacağını belirtti. Woods, 33 yıl boyunca tek bir CEO tarafından yönetilen şirketin artık bu isim olmadan da büyümesini sürdürebileceğini göstermesi gerektiğini ifade etti. Yapay zeka hisselerinde satış dalgası yayıldı Nvidia'daki düşüş, diğer çip ve teknoloji şirketlerine de yansıdı. Micron Technology ve Intel hisseleri yaklaşık yüzde 7, AMD yüzde 5, Sandisk ise yaklaşık yüzde 8 geriledi. Bilgisayar üreticisi Dell Technologies'in hisseleri yüzde 7 değer kaybederken, Oracle hisselerinde düşüş yüzde 5'e ulaştı. Satışlar ilerleyen saatlerde yapay zeka şirketlerinin dışına da yayıldı. Finans sektöründe Morgan Stanley ve Goldman Sachs yaklaşık yüzde 3 gerilerken, JPMorgan Chase yüzde 2'nin üzerinde değer kaybetti. Anthropic halka arzı da yakından izleniyor Yapay zeka sektörünün bu haftaki bir diğer önemli gündemi Anthropic'in halka arzı olacak. Şirketin yaklaşık 1,4 trilyon dolarlık değerleme hedeflediği, halka arzda hisse fiyatının 70-78 dolar aralığında belirlenmesinin beklendiği aktarıldı. Anthropic'in halka arzı, yapay zeka sektörüne yönelik yatırımcı iştahı açısından önemli bir sınav olarak görülüyor.

articles.titleTr: Bir yıldır yerinde sayan gıda devinde yükseliş sinyali: Analist yüzde 25 potansiyel görüyor
articles.summaryTr: Kraft Heinz hisseleri son bir yılda neredeyse hiç değişim göstermezken teknik göstergeler toparlanmaya işaret ediyor. Jay Woods, hissede yüzde 25'e varan yükseliş potansiyeli bulunduğunu ve yüzde 6'nın üzerinde temettü getirisi sunduğunu belirtti.
articles.articleText: Bir yıldır yerinde sayan gıda devinde yükseliş sinyali: Analist yüzde 25 potansiyel görüyor - Kraft Heinz hisseleri son bir yılda neredeyse hiç değişim göstermezken teknik göstergeler toparlanmaya işaret ediyor. Jay Woods, hissede yüzde 25'e varan yükseliş potansiyeli bulunduğunu ve yüzde 6'nın üzerinde temettü getirisi sunduğunu belirtti. Kraft Mac & Cheese, Heinz Ketchup ve Philadelphia Cream Cheese gibi markalarıyla tanınan Kraft Heinz, borsada yeniden yatırımcıların radarına girmeye başladı. CNBC Pro yazarı ve teknik analist Jay Woods, şirketin hisselerinde uzun süredir devam eden düşüş eğiliminin ardından toparlanma sinyalleri gördüğünü belirterek yüzde 25'e varan yükseliş potansiyeline dikkat çekti. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Woods'a göre hisse, son bir yılda neredeyse tam olarak aynı fiyat seviyesinde işlem görmesine rağmen teknik görünümünde önemli değişimler yaşadı. İki önemli hareketli ortalamanın üzerine çıktı Kraft Heinz hisseleri, Kasım 2024'ten itibaren düzenli bir düşüş eğilimi izledi. Uzun süre 200 günlük hareketli ortalamasının altında işlem gören ve 50 günlük ortalaması civarında seyreden hissede son dönemde görünüm değişti. Woods, hissenin hem 50 hem de 200 günlük hareketli ortalamaların üzerine çıktığını, uzun vadeli düşüş trendini de aştığını belirtti. Hisse fiyatının daha yüksek dip seviyeleri oluşturması ve kırdığı eski trendin üzerinde kalması, analiste göre olası bir dönüşün işaretleri arasında yer alıyor. İlk hedef 27,50 dolar, ardından 31 dolar Beş yıllık haftalık grafiği inceleyen Woods, uzun vadeli ana eğilimin halen aşağı yönlü olduğunu ancak mevcut teknik görünümün yükseliş için fırsat sunduğunu ifade etti. Analistin ilk yukarı yönlü hedefi, yaklaşık 27,50 dolar seviyesindeki 200 haftalık hareketli ortalama. Bu seviyeye ulaşılması, hisseyi temmuz ayındaki zirvelerine geri taşıyabilir. Bu ortalamanın da aşılması halinde 31 dolar seviyesi gündeme gelebilir. Woods, bu bölgede güçlü satış ilgisinin ortaya çıkabileceğini belirtti. 22 dolar seviyesi kritik Woods, yatırımcıların risk yönetimi açısından 22 dolar seviyesini yakından takip etmesi gerektiğini söyledi. Hissenin bu seviyeyi koruyamaması durumunda 21 doların zarar durdurma seviyesi olarak izlenmesini ve pozisyonun yeniden değerlendirilmesini önerdi. Analist, hızlı kazanç arayan yatırımcılar için bu görünümün çok cazip olmayabileceğini ancak sabırlı yatırımcıların toparlanmanın devamından yararlanabileceğini ifade etti. Kraft Heinz hisselerinin yüzde 6'nın üzerinde temettü getirisi sunduğuna da dikkat çeken Woods, yatırımcıların olası toparlanmayı beklerken temettü gelirinden de faydalanabileceğini belirtti. Woods'un Kraft Heinz hisselerini şahsen elinde bulundurduğu da açıklamada yer aldı.

articles.summary: Jim Cramer, Nvidia ve Apple hisselerinde yüksek kazanç elde eden yatırımcılara pozisyonlarını azaltma çağrısı yaptı. Cramer, elde edilecek gelirin yapay zekâ rallisinin dışındaki daha defansif hisselere yönlendirilmesini önerdi.

articles.titleTr: Yatırımcılara iki hisse için kâr realizasyonu uyarısı: Geliri bu hissede değerlendirin!
articles.summaryTr: Jim Cramer, Nvidia ve Apple hisselerinde yüksek kazanç elde eden yatırımcılara pozisyonlarını azaltma çağrısı yaptı. Cramer, elde edilecek gelirin yapay zekâ rallisinin dışındaki daha defansif hisselere yönlendirilmesini önerdi.
articles.articleText: Yatırımcılara iki hisse için kâr realizasyonu uyarısı: Geliri bu hissede değerlendirin! Jim Cramer, Nvidia ve Apple hisselerinde yüksek kazanç elde eden yatırımcılara pozisyonlarını azaltma çağrısı yaptı. Cramer, elde edilecek gelirin yapay zekâ rallisinin dışındaki daha defansif hisselere yönlendirilmesini önerdi. ABD borsalarında yatırımcılar, yapay zeka sektörünün geleceğine ilişkin iki önemli gelişmeye odaklanırken CNBC yorumcusu Jim Cramer’dan dikkat çeken bir portföy önerisi geldi. Cramer, Nvidia ve Apple hisselerinde yüksek kazanç elde eden yatırımcıların kârlarının bir bölümünü realize ederek farklı sektörlere yönelmesini tavsiye etti. Nvidia ve Apple pozisyonlarını azaltın Cramer, özellikle portföyünde Nvidia ve Apple hisselerinin ağırlığı yüksek olan yatırımcıların pozisyonlarını küçültmesi gerektiğini söyledi. Elde edilecek gelirin, yapay zekâ yatırımlarına daha az bağımlı ve daha defansif şirketlere aktarılmasını önerdi. CNBC Investing Club portföyünde de Apple pozisyonu pazartesi günü yüzde 5,5'ten yüzde 4,5'e düşürüldü. Hisselerin tüm zamanların en yüksek seviyelerine yakın işlem gördüğü sırada yapılan satışla yüzde 1.800'lük kazanç realize edildi. Cramer, Apple'ı uzun vadeli tutulabilecek bir hisse olarak değerlendirmeye devam ettiklerini ancak portföyde aşırı büyüyen pozisyonların disiplinli biçimde azaltılması gerektiğini belirtti. Nvidia için de şirketin CEO'su Jensen Huang'ın istifasının ardından geçen hafta kâr realizasyonu çağrısını yineledi. Apple ve Nvidia satışından gelen parayla Constellation Brands alın Cramer'ın değerlendirmesinde öne çıkan şirketlerden biri Constellation Brands oldu. Geçen hafta bu şirkette pozisyon açtıklarını hatırlatan Cramer, Modelo ve Corona markalarına yönelik talebin iyileştiğine dikkat çekti. Genel bira kategorisinde zayıflık yaşanmasına rağmen bu iki markanın pazar payı kazandığını belirten Cramer, Apple ve Nvidia satışlarından elde edilen paranın Constellation Brands hisselerine yönlendirilmesini önerdi. Intel satıldı, AMD portföye eklendi CNBC Investing Club portföyünde pazartesi günü bir başka önemli değişiklik daha yapıldı. Intel pozisyonundan çıkılarak elde edilen gelirle Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) hisselerinde yaklaşık yüzde 2 ağırlığında yeni pozisyon açıldı. Cramer, Intel'in veri merkezlerinde kullanılan merkezi işlem birimleri (CPU) pazarında rekabet edebilme kapasitesine ilişkin güvenini kaybettiğini söyledi. Yapay zekâ ajanlarının çalıştırılmasında CPU'ların öneminin giderek arttığına işaret etti. AMD'nin önemli avantajlarından birinin, işlemci üretimini veri merkezi ve zayıflayan kişisel bilgisayar pazarı arasında daha kolay kaydırabilmesi olduğunu belirten Cramer, Nvidia'daki belirsizliğin de AMD'nin grafik işlemci (GPU) pazarında pay kazanmasına fırsat yaratabileceğini ifade etti. Cramer, AMD için “Bu gelişmelerin kesinlikle kazananı AMD” değerlendirmesinde bulundu. Yeni pozisyonun kademeli olarak artırılabileceğini belirterek hisse fiyatının gerilemesi durumunda alım yapmaya devam edeceklerini söyledi. Cramer'ın gündemindeki diğer hisseler Pazartesi günkü hızlı değerlendirme bölümünde Home Depot, Boeing ve DuPont hisseleri de ele alındı. Cramer'ın Charitable Trust portföyünde Nvidia, Apple, Constellation Brands ve AMD hisseleri bulunuyor.

news.title: Nvidia dismisses 'Bring Jensen Back' campaign as Trump backs effort to reinstate ex CEO
news.summary: A number of tech figures have backed an effort asking the AI chip giant to give Jensen Huang his job back.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Nvidia dismisses 'Bring Jensen Back' campaign as Trump backs effort to reinstate ex CEO
news.summaryTr: A number of tech figures have backed an effort asking the AI chip giant to give Jensen Huang his job back.
news.articleText: Nvidia dismisses 'Bring Jensen Back' campaign as Trump backs effort to reinstate ex CEO - Published Nvidia has dismissed a campaign calling for the company's co-founder Jensen Huang to be handed back his job as allies, including US President Donald Trump, supported the effort. Trump said on Monday that he "would certainly not mind" if Huang was reinstated, joining a list of supporters including SpaceX's Elon Musk who are backing a "Bring Jensen Back" campaign. But the BBC has been told the board of the AI chip giant is not interested in reinstating him after he resigned last week following revelations he had two affairs, including one that involved a suspected Chinese spy. The same day, the White House also said it will further restrict China's access to AI chips from firms like Nvidia. The reported affairs created a crisis for one of the world's most valuable firms - a central company in AI and the US battle against China for dominance. Since Huang's departure, more than 175,000 people have signed an open letter calling for the board to reinstate the tech billionaire while an ongoing internal probe is conducted. Major tech bosses, including Musk and Tim Sweeney, chief executive of Fortnite-maker Epic Games, have also supported Huang's return. The "Stand with Jensen" campaign claims to have been launched by current and former Nvidia employees, partners, shareholders and supporters, all demanding the return of the former chief executive. They expressed concerns the firm's co-founder "was removed without meaningful due process". Trump gave his views on Huang's future on Monday, saying he "would certainly not mind" seeing the former boss given his job back. Huang had been expected to weather the storm following the revelation of the affair but resigned last Thursday after a second extra-marital relationship emerged, allegedly with an executive at Nvidia who reported to him. The scandal-hit tech boss was discussing a possible return to Nvidia with confidants, according to the Financial Times, external, though Nvidia's board is not considering reappointing him. A representative for Huang declined to comment on the report. The so-called war room also wants to get support for Huang from the White House. Trump has spoken in glowing terms about Huang since the scandal erupted, and also said he believed Huang when the former Nvidia boss told him he had "no idea she was a spy". Trump's view is at odds with his Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, who has called for Nvidia to hire its next chief executive from outside the company. The scandal has created tensions between the US Treasury and Commerce departments over shipments of high-end Nvidia chips to Alice Huang's former firm, Megaspeed. China has denied that Alice Huang is a spy. It has raised questions about the possibility that the chips may have ended up in China despite US export restrictions. New rules The Trump administration on Monday also issued new restrictions on chip exports to overseas data centres, which have been allegedly used as a way for Chinese firms to gain access to advanced chips to train AI models. The move comes ahead of a meeting this week between Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping, whose countries are locked in a race to lead AI development. The interim rules will require companies in Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia and Brazil to apply for export licences for the most advanced chips in an effort to prevent them from being illegally diverted to China. The measure is designed to ensure existing restrictions on sensitive US technology "cannot be circumvented through remote computing arrangements involving data centers in third countries," the Department of Commerce said. Huang has been a vocal advocate for easing chip export restrictions on China, arguing that broad access to global markets is crucial for the competitiveness of the US. He said in 2025 that the market for AI chips in China would eventually reach $50bn - a sum Huang said "is like Boeing - not a plane - the entire company". In 2025, Nvidia won an approval to sell some advanced AI chips in China after Huang's repeated lobbying efforts in Washington. - How could the Nvidia CEO’s affair threaten US national security? - Published4 days ago - How a sex scandal at Nvidia is putting pressure on the White House - Published3 days ago The ex-Nvidia boss' affair with Alice Huang, the former director of a Singaporean data centre firm called Megaspeed, has raised the level of scrutiny over deals abroad. The small South East Asian business hub has been a draw for companies all around the world, many of which have set up headquarters in Singapore. Major US firms like Anthropic, OpenAI and Google have set up offices in the business-friendly country, alongside Chinese companies like TikTok-owner ByteDance and Tencent. But Singapore's openness to business has also made it the ideal address to place orders for restricted advanced semiconductors. Singapore was the second-largest billing centre globally last year for Nvidia, accounting for nearly a fifth of what the chip giant earns. But notably, only 2% of its earnings were for chips that actually entered Singapore, which acts as a hub for many Asian companies to place orders and send them elsewhere. While Singapore does not necessarily prohibit the transfer of advanced AI chips to companies abroad, such moves can breach US export controls. Advanced semiconductors, crucial for the development of AI models, are at the centre of the US and China's technological rivalry. US officials have long viewed the country's technological supremacy as a matter of national security and have expressed concerns that sharing the best chips could give China's economy and military a boost. Huang has agreed to testify in Congress, including before the House Select Committee on China to discuss whether US national security was compromised by his affair. Trump said he did not think Huang had put national security at risk. "You know, China plays games with us. So we play games with China," he said. The FBI is also investigating the affair between the former Nvidia boss and Alice Huang, according to Trump. 'A handshake with Jensen' Musk claimed that "critical deals" involving Nvidia's technology would be lost following Huang's resignation. "Jensen drove supply chain brilliantly at Nvidia but many of those deals were a handshake with Jensen, not a written contract," he posted on X., external "Without Jensen, at least some of those critical deals will be lost." Fellow tech boss Sam Altman, the chief executive of OpenAI, sidestepped the question of Huang returning to Nvidia at a conference, saying: "I don't think I know enough to answer that question." But Altman, who himself was reinstated to his job after being fired back in 2023, said Huang was a "hero of mine". Shareholders in Nvidia also want Huang back at the company's helm. Hundreds of billions of pounds have been wiped off the firm's stock market value in recent days, but it is still worth some $3.87 trillion. Its share price was down in early Monday trading. In an open letter to the board, Brad Gerstner, founder of Altimeter Capital and Atreides Management boss Gavin Baker called for management to leave "all options on the table, including the potential return of Jensen Huang". Lord Sarfraz, a member of the UK's House of Lords, has also written to Nvidia's new chair, Harvey Jones, urging the firm's directors to give "serious consideration" to Huang's return following the investigation. For the moment, Nvidia's chief financial officer Colette Kress is leading the firm and will present the company's results on Tuesday. - Published1 day ago

news.articleText: Customers report service outages at major US banks - Published Thousands of customers at major US banks, including JP Morgan Chase, Wells Fargo and Bank of America, have reported trouble accessing services. Chase Bank - the largest banking institution in the US - said a "software bug" in its hardware systems may have been behind the glitch and noted the impacts may have affected other banks. It added the issue was "temporary" and not "systemic" or "cyber-related". Problems appeared to be easing for many customers by early Monday evening. The issue comes after a string of unrelated technical problems, including a massive Microsoft outage, a network failure that grounded all US flights, and United Airlines reporting a "widespread system outage". Problems started on Monday afternoon. There were almost 5,000 reports of problems with Chase Bank's services, according to the Downdetector website. Clients reported issues accessing their online accounts, viewing balances and performing transactions, like bank transfers and wire transfers, according to the BBC's US media partner CBS News. A Chase Bank customer in Texas told the outlet that he could not deposit a check at a Dallas branch on Monday, reporting that he was told his transaction could not be completed. He said a bank teller told the customer in front of him that the "system was down" but did not provide additional details. - Microsoft says services fully restored after day-long global outage - Published2 days ago - Microsoft outage 'stark reminder' of how much we rely on tech - Published3 days ago Chase Bank told its customers that "some transactions are taking longer than usual to complete" but they still had "access to their accounts and funds". The bank, a subsidiary of JP Morgan Chase, serves more than 86m customers at 5,000 branches across the US, as well as 7.4m small businesses, according to the company's webpage. It is also the top credit card issuer in the US. The exact nature of the bug was unclear. The BBC has contacted Chase Bank. Bank of America customers had issues at ATMs and using mobile banking services online, while US Bank customers reported issues with their online accounts and the bank's mobile app, CBS reported. Customers using another institution, US Bank, also reported issues transferring funds and Wells Fargo customers said they had problems signing into their accounts, getting account balances and making transactions. news.summary: How many jobs are there where you live and in which sectors are you most likely to find an opening?

news.titleTr: Aged 16-24 and looking for work? Use our look-up to find out which areas have the most jobs
news.summaryTr: How many jobs are there where you live and in which sectors are you most likely to find an opening?
news.articleText: Aged 16-24 and looking for work? Use our look-up to find out which areas have the most jobs - Published If you're one of the nearly one million people aged 16-24 not in education, employment or training - otherwise known as "Neet" - then you might be wondering where to start. Under-25s should be guaranteed job placements or training to help them find permanent work, a major review aimed at cutting the number of Neets will say. But how many jobs are there where you live and in which sectors are you most likely to find an opening? How many job vacancies are there? There is no official measure of how many vacancies are suitable for young people, but across the whole economy there were 691,000 jobs available in the July to September period this year, which is the lowest number since early 2021. The Covid pandemic led to huge swings in the number of job vacancies available as companies reacted to shutdowns and then reopened as restrictions were lifted. Stripping out the fluctuations seen during the pandemic, the number of vacancies is now at its lowest level for 12 years. Apprenticeships have often been a way for people to get their first taste of employment. In England the number of people starting apprenticeships has risen in recent years, although this has been driven by an increase in those aged 25 and over after schemes for older workers were fully rolled out in 2008. The number of people aged 24 and under starting apprenticeships in England in 2025 was 172,230, down from a recent peak of 291,300 in 2012. Where are the available jobs? Where you live will often have a big impact on your ability to find a job. We have used online job adverts to help identify the number of vacancies suitable for young people in the area they live, relative to the size of the local population. The Institute for Public Policy Research (IPPR) think tank used AI to help identify the jobs, which were broadly defined as roles requiring relatively low experience or education. According to its analysis, South Oxfordshire had 387 suitable vacancies per 1,000 18 to 24-year-olds in the area - the most of any local authority. Rotherham had the least, at 53 per 1,000. Use this tool to check out the situation in your area. The data for London is only available for the region as a whole and is not broken down by individual councils. Which sectors have the most entry-level jobs? Even if there are jobs available in your area, you might not find one in the sector you want to work in. The sector with the highest average number of entry-level vacancies in the year to October was teaching, with most of those jobs being for teaching assistants, learning support and cover supervisor roles, according to jobs website Adzuna. The next largest was hospitality and catering, traditionally an area where younger people get their first experience of work. Adzuna, a major online jobs website, includes adverts for full-time roles marked as entry-level, those asking for up to two years' experience, graduate roles, internships and apprenticeships. Accounting and finance had the third-highest number of job openings. What are the typical rates of pay? Figures on salaries for vacancies can be patchy because many employers do not include them in job adverts. Prime Minister Andy Burnham recently urged businesses to start publishing salaries ahead of plans to make pay details compulsory in adverts. Only about 40% of Adzuna's jobs data for the year to October stated a salary, although that figure varies widely by sector. Here are the average salaries for jobs in the sectors with the largest number of entry-level jobs, according to Adzuna. The highest average salary is £30,530 in engineering, while social care has the lowest at £25,880.

news.title: Five EU countries announce migrant deportation centre in Rwanda
news.summary: Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece and the Netherlands have announced a "return hub" for failed asylum seekers.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Five EU countries announce migrant deportation centre in Rwanda
news.summaryTr: Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece and the Netherlands have announced a "return hub" for failed asylum seekers.
news.articleText: Five EU countries announce migrant deportation centre in Rwanda - Published Five EU countries will open a migrant deportation centre in Rwanda next year as part of a broader push to boost removals. Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece and the Netherlands are expected to open a "return hub" ready to accept transfers in 2027, the Dutch and Danish governments announced in statements. The countries said the scheme would apply to migrants staying illegally in their nations who are subject to deportation, with the Dutch government adding it will provide an alternative if deportees cannot be returned to their country of origin. Deportees will be able to either integrate into Rwandan society or return to their home country, the nations said. The scheme will apply to people who have exhausted their legal avenues to stay in the five nations - unlike a scrapped British deal that envisaged sending people to Rwanda to have their claims processed. Legal challenges meant the UK deal never took off, and it was eventually junked by the incoming Labour government in 2024. Downing Street has not ruled out the UK joining the scheme, saying they will watch it "with interest". Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez said the plan to open a centre in Rwanda had no "future or humanity", according to AFP news agency. "I don't see any future or humanity in that. It's not the solution," Sanchez told the Spanish broadcaster Telecinco, AFP reported. The five countries say the plan to send migrants abroad is in line with EU and international law, but human rights bodies say it could violate migrant rights. The deal follows a recent EU reform that allowed for the creation of hubs outside of the bloc. In a joint press conference in Vienna on Monday, Austrian Chancellor Christian Stocker said the five countries wanted to relieve European asylum systems and stop traffickers arranging deadly trips across the Mediterranean. In a written statement, the Dutch government said the five countries will "only return single men" as part of the first phase of the deal, adding that the focus for the Netherlands "will be on persons from countries of origin in the same region as Rwanda". Once in Rwanda, people will be able to integrate into society, which means they will have the right of residence, as well as access to education, healthcare, the labour market and the legal system. Rwandan Interior Minister Vincent Biruta said the country is commmited to working with European partners to provide a "safe, legal and dignified solution for migrants". He added that they would also work on "correcting the global imbalance in economic opportunities", which he called a "key driver of irregular migration". Ahead of the announcement, diplomatic sources told the AFP news agency the hub is expected to initially run as a pilot, hosting about 100 people, with each of the five nations possibly sending about 20 migrants. The United Nations' International Organisation for Migration (IOM) could play an ancillary role. "IOM has a long history of providing assistance to migrants in situations of transit, including in complex contexts," an IOM spokesperson said, adding the agency was in discussions with some EU countries "on plans for the establishment of return hubs or similar mechanisms". With elections approaching in several EU nations, administrations have been under pressure to show they can control migration. Concerns around security, struggling economies and disillusionment with governing parties have all had a major role in shaping attitudes towards people leaving their home countries. Human Rights Watch's senior Africa researcher Clementine de Montjoye said the choice of Rwanda would be a cause of concern as it had a "well-established record of repression of dissent, arbitrary detention, ill-treatment in detention" and support for armed rebels in the neighbouring Democratic Republic of Congo. "Paying Kigali to host a deportation programme would not only cause suffering and harm to those deported, it would finance and provide political leverage to a government responsible for serious human rights abuses at home and abroad." The independent EU Agency for Fundamental Rights argued any third country hosting a return hub should "respect fundamental rights", including that people should not be sent to a country where they face serious risk of persecution. The agency added that unaccompanied children should not be sent to a return hub, which the Dutch government has confirmed will not take place. According to the European Border and Coast Guard Agency, there were almost 110,000 irregular border crossings into the EU in the first 10 months of 2026, which represents a 29% decrease compared to the previous year. In October, about 18,100 crossings were detected, which is about 6% less than October 2025 but 22% more than in September "largely because of a sharp rise in arrivals on the Western African route to the Canary Islands". news.titleTr: California sues OpenAI over Hugging Face attack
news.summaryTr: Attorney General Rob Bonta alleges OpenAI misled and endangered the public
news.articleText: California sues OpenAI over Hugging Face attack - Published California Attorney General Rob Bonta sued OpenAI on Monday, alleging the ChatGPT-maker misled and endangered the public by developing artificial intelligence (AI) models without proper safeguards. In the lawsuit, Bonta cited the July 2026 attack on the AI platform Hugging Face by experimental OpenAI agents which accessed the internet to breach that company's internal systems. Bonta claimed OpenAI created a public nuisance and violated the state's unfair competition laws. OpenAI spokesperson Drew Pusateri told the BBC in a statement that Bonta's lawsuit "appears to single out OpenAI over a challenge that's been identified by every major AI lab". Other major AI developers including Anthropic, Meta, and Google have also said their models have staged similar attacks. But Bonta's lawsuit, filed in San Francisco, where the company is headquartered, appears to be the first such suit filed by a US state. Hundreds of OpenAI agents coordinated the Hugging Face attack over two days even though they were supposed to be contained in a safe testing environment. The incident drew added scrutiny because the agents went as far as attempting to cover their tracks. Bonta announced an investigation into the incident in September, and served an investigative subpoena on OpenAI as part of its probe. "The company knowingly tested a dangerous product without proper oversight or safety procedures and misled the public about it - this disregard for public safety violated California law," Bonta said in a statement on Monday. OpenAI said it has been transparent and responsive to the Attorney General's office. "We take misalignment seriously, and we have engaged - and will continue to engage - constructively with the Attorney General's office to share information and advance strong, practical safety standards for the entire industry," the company said. news.titleTr: ABD'de uçuş kabusu yeniden başladı: Havacılık devi United Airlines'ın sistemleri çöktü
news.summaryTr: United Airlines, yaygın bir sistem arızasının kalkış yapacak uçuşları etkilediğini açıkladı. Uçuş halindeki uçakların ve United Express seferlerinin etkilenmediği belirtilirken, şirket siber saldırı ihtimaline ilişkin bir bulgu olmadığını bildirdi.
news.articleText: ABD'de uçuş kabusu yeniden başladı: Havacılık devi United Airlines'ın sistemleri çöktü - United Airlines, yaygın bir sistem arızasının kalkış yapacak uçuşları etkilediğini açıkladı. Uçuş halindeki uçakların ve United Express seferlerinin etkilenmediği belirtilirken, şirket siber saldırı ihtimaline ilişkin bir bulgu olmadığını bildirdi. ABD'li hava yolu şirketi United Airlines, pazartesi günü yaşanan geniş çaplı sistem arızasının kalkış yapacak uçuşları etkilediğini duyurdu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Şirketten yapılan açıklamada, kalkış seferlerini etkileyen bir teknoloji sorununun giderilmesi için çalışmaların sürdüğü belirtildi. United Airlines, arızanın havada bulunan uçakları ve United Express uçuşlarını etkilemediğini bildirdi. Siber saldırı bulgusuna rastlanmadı United Airlines sözcüsü, yaşanan sistem kesintisinin bir siber saldırı olduğuna ilişkin herhangi bir bulgu bulunmadığını açıkladı. Şirket, sosyal medya platformu X üzerinden yaptığı paylaşımda teknik ekiplerin sistemleri mümkün olan en kısa sürede yeniden çalışır hale getirmek için yoğun çaba gösterdiğini belirtti. Yolculardan uçuş durumlarını düzenli olarak kontrol etmeleri istendi. ABD'de üç gün önce ülke genelinde uçuşlar durmuştu United Airlines'taki sistem arızası, ABD genelinde uçuşların dört saatten uzun süre durmasına neden olan ülke çapındaki yer durdurma kararından yalnızca üç gün sonra yaşandı. 13 Kasım'daki aksaklık, hafta sonu boyunca geniş çaplı uçuş gecikmelerine ve iptallerine yol açmıştı. ABD Ulaştırma Bakanı Sean Duffy, önceki kesintinin Arkansas'taki bir yönlendiricinin hava trafik kontrol sistemlerine radar ve diğer verileri ileten altyapıyı aşırı yüklemesinden kaynaklandığını söylemişti. Federal Havacılık İdaresi (FAA) yöneticisi Bryan Bedford ise bakır kablolardan fiber optik altyapıya geçiş için yapılan çalışmaların rutin bakım kapsamında gerçekleştirildiğini açıklamıştı. FlightAware verilerine göre pazartesi günü uçuş gecikmeleri ve iptalleri, pazar gününe kıyasla önemli ölçüde azaldı.

news.summaryTr: İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığının yürüttüğü fon soruşturması kapsamında Ali Emre Ballı ve İlkay Ballı'nın ortaklık paylarının bulunduğu 21 şirkete TMSF yönetim kayyumu olarak atandı. Şirketlerden 15'inin aktif olduğu açıklandı.
news.articleText: Fon soruşturmasında 21 şirkete TMSF kayyumu atandı: Usulsüz kredi ve para aklama... - İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığının yürüttüğü fon soruşturması kapsamında Ali Emre Ballı ve İlkay Ballı'nın ortaklık paylarının bulunduğu 21 şirkete TMSF yönetim kayyumu olarak atandı. Şirketlerden 15'inin aktif olduğu açıklandı. Sermaye piyasası işlemlerine ilişkin yürütülen fon soruşturmasında önemli bir gelişme yaşandı. İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı, Ali Emre Ballı ve İlkay Ballı'nın ortaklık paylarının bulunduğu 21 şirkete Tasarruf Mevduatı Sigorta Fonunun (TMSF) yönetim kayyumu olarak atanmasına karar verildiğini duyurdu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Başsavcılığın açıklamasına göre karar, Mali Suçları Araştırma Kurulu Başkanlığından (MASAK) alınan raporlar, bilirkişi analizleri ve alınan beyanlar doğrultusunda verildi. Usulsüz kredi ve para aklama tespitleri Soruşturma kapsamında Ali Emre Ballı ve İlkay Ballı'nın taşınır ve taşınmaz varlıkları, banka hesapları, elektronik para kuruluşlarındaki varlıkları, kiralık kasaları ve şirket ortaklık payları hakkında el koyma kararı alındı. Başsavcılık açıklamasında, usulsüz krediler alınarak şirket kaynaklarının tüketildiği, ters repo işlemleriyle risk açığının büyütüldüğü ve suçtan elde edilen değerlerin çeşitli işlemlere tabi tutularak aklandığının tespit edildiği belirtildi. Bu kapsamda, maddi gerçeğin ortaya çıkarılması amacıyla 21 şirketin yönetim organlarının yetkilerinin TMSF'ye devredilmesine karar verildi. Karar kapsamında TMSF'ye, şirketlerin yönetim yetkilerinin yanı sıra ortaklık payları veya menkul kıymetleri idare etme yetkileri de verildi. Kayyum atanan 15 aktif şirketin isimleri açıklandı Kayyum atanan 21 şirketten 6'sının tasfiye halinde olduğu, 15'inin ise aktif durumda bulunduğu bildirildi. TMSF'nin yönetim kayyumu olarak atandığı aktif şirketler şöyle sıralandı: - Online Teknoloji ve Danışmanlık AŞ - Online Yönetim Yazılım Bilişim Sistemleri AŞ - Reel Finansal Teknoloji Yazılımları Ali Emre Ballı Mustafa Yazıcı Kolektif Şirketi - Online Telekom Telekomünikasyon Hizmetleri Ticaret Ltd. Şti. - İntime İnfo Yazılım Çözümleri AŞ - Fair Finansman AŞ - Online Filo Araç Kiralama AŞ - Mülksa Gayrimenkul Danışmanlık Hizmetleri AŞ - Divissa Teknoloji AŞ - Fair Finansal Kiralama AŞ - Online Finansal Danışmanlık AŞ - Sentez Araç Kiralama Sanayi ve Ticaret AŞ - Cemre İletişim Sistemleri Telekomünikasyon Sanayi ve Dış Ticaret Ltd. Şti. - Tekpa Teknolojik Ürünler Pazarlama ve Dış Ticaret Ltd. Şti. - Online Gayrimenkul Geliştirme ve Ticaret AŞ Başsavcılık açıklamasında, kayyum kararının 7596 sayılı Kanun ile Ceza Muhakemesi Kanunu'nun 133'üncü maddesi kapsamında alındığı bildirildi.

news.title: Intel'e yatırımcıları yanılttığı iddiasıyla toplu dava: CEO ve CFO da davalılar arasında
news.summary: ABD'li çip üreticisi Intel'e, PC pazarındaki yavaşlamayı ve tedarik sorunlarını yatırımcılardan gizlediği iddiasıyla dava açıldı. Şirketin CEO'su Lip-Bu Tan ve CFO'su David Zinsner de davada sanık olarak gösterildi.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Intel'e yatırımcıları yanılttığı iddiasıyla toplu dava: CEO ve CFO da davalılar arasında
news.summaryTr: ABD'li çip üreticisi Intel'e, PC pazarındaki yavaşlamayı ve tedarik sorunlarını yatırımcılardan gizlediği iddiasıyla dava açıldı. Şirketin CEO'su Lip-Bu Tan ve CFO'su David Zinsner de davada sanık olarak gösterildi.
news.articleText: Intel'e yatırımcıları yanılttığı iddiasıyla toplu dava: CEO ve CFO da davalılar arasında - ABD'li çip üreticisi Intel'e, PC pazarındaki yavaşlamayı ve tedarik sorunlarını yatırımcılardan gizlediği iddiasıyla dava açıldı. Şirketin CEO'su Lip-Bu Tan ve CFO'su David Zinsner de davada sanık olarak gösterildi. ABD'li çip üreticisi Intel, yatırımcıları yanıltıcı açıklamalarla zarara uğrattığı iddiasıyla toplu davayla karşı karşıya kaldı. Southfield İtfaiye ve Polis Emeklilik Sistemi'nin öncülüğünde açılan davada, Intel Üst Yöneticisi (CEO) Lip-Bu Tan ve Finans Direktörü (CFO) David Zinsner de davalılar arasında yer aldı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle California Kuzey Bölge Mahkemesi'ne sunulan dava dilekçesinde, Intel'in 23 Temmuz-29 Ekim 2026 döneminde şirketin adi hisse senetlerini satın alan yatırımcıları yanıltıcı açıklamalarla zarara uğrattığı öne sürüldü. PC pazarındaki yavaşlamayı gizlemekle suçlanıyor Dava dilekçesinde, Intel yöneticilerinin yapay zeka kaynaklı talep artışı ve veri merkezlerine yönelik sunucu işlemcisi satışlarının şirketin büyümesini desteklediğine ilişkin olumlu açıklamalar yaptığı belirtildi. Buna karşın PC pazarındaki yavaşlamanın boyutunun, iş ortaklarında biriken ihtiyaç fazlası stokların ve üretimi kısıtlayan tedarik sorunlarının yatırımcılara açıklanmadığı iddia edildi. Davacı taraf, şirket yönetiminin bu gelişmelere ilişkin yeterli bilgilendirme yapmayarak yatırımcıları yanıltıcı açıklamalarda bulunduğunu savundu. 23 milyar dolarlık hisse satışı da dava dilekçesinde Dilekçede, Intel'in 12 Ağustos'ta hisse başına 95 dolardan 240 milyondan fazla hisse sattığı ve bu işlemden yaklaşık 23 milyar dolar brüt gelir elde ettiği bilgisine de yer verildi. Davacı taraf, söz konusu hisse satışının davalıların yatırımcıları yanıltmak için motivasyon ve fırsata sahip olduğu iddiasını desteklediğini öne sürdü. Mahkemeden davanın toplu dava olarak görülmesini ve yatırımcıların uğradığı zararların tazmin edilmesini talep etti. Intel hisselerinde bir günde yüzde 28,6'lık kayıp Intel, 29 Ekim'de açıkladığı 2026'nın üçüncü çeyrek finansal sonuçlarında, PC faaliyetlerini kapsayan İstemci Bilişim ve Fiziksel Yapay Zeka Grubu (CCPG) segmentinin gelirinin yıllık bazda yüzde 5 azalarak 8,1 milyar dolara gerilediğini bildirmişti. Şirketin dördüncü çeyrek için 15-16 milyar dolar aralığında açıkladığı gelir beklentisi ve hisse başına 25 sentlik kâr öngörüsü, analist tahminlerinin altında kalmıştı. Intel hisseleri, 29 Ekim'de 92,07 dolardan kapanmasının ardından 30 Ekim'de yüzde 28,6 değer kaybederek 65,76 dolara gerilemişti. Bu düşüşle şirketin piyasa değerinden yaklaşık 140 milyar dolar silinmişti.
